Subject: Annual commitment — invoicing & tax coordination

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As we finalize the annual committed spend for 2027, finance has asked me to get a single, consolidated schedule they can share with AP for prepay collections and the monthly sweep we discussed. Can you confirm the following so we can book the funds: 

- A one-line invoice cadence (e.g., quarterly invoices with monthly drawdowns / single upfront + monthly burn reports)
- Whether Redwood will gross-up for any withholding tax in India/UK or if OmniHealth should remit net and provide proof of withholding
- Expected invoice remit details (wire instructions + EIN/Tax ID) and whether a signed MOA/MSA needs to be returned before the first sweep
- Any standard GL/description to include so our ERP maps correctly

If you can send the proposed dates and a sample invoice template we can circulate to AP. Attaching our vendor request form (see separate email).

Best,
Nora
Nora Patel
Head of Procurement
OmniHealth

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@omnihealth.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T15:27:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Annual commitment — invoicing & tax coordination

Hi Nora — thanks for the clear list. Drafting a consolidated plan and attaching the schedule for AP to review. High level: 

1) Billing cadence we recommend
   - Issue one annual commitment invoice on contract execution (covers committed credit)
   - Monthly sweep / drawdown on the committed credit on the 15th of each month against monthly usage reports
   - Quarterly statement (PDF) and a single adjustment invoice if usage exceeds committed amount in the quarter

2) Withholding / gross-up
   - Redwood typically invoices gross. If OmniHealth is required to withhold by local tax rules, you should remit net and provide a withholding receipt; Redwood will credit the retained amount against the commitment.
   - For UK customers where reverse-charge VAT may apply, we can issue an invoice with reverse-charge wording; for India, we typically treat payments as net unless customer requests gross-up.

3) Remit / tax identifiers
   - Wire: Redwood Inference, Bank: First Pacific Bank, SWIFT: FPACUS33, Account: 0123456789
   - US Tax ID: 12-3456789; VAT registration available on invoice when required

4) Next steps and docs
   - Attached: commitment_sweep_schedule_v3.xlsx (dates and GL mapping)
   - Please return signed MOA before the first sweep if possible — we'll generate the invoice once we have a countersigned copy

Can Marcus or Soojin add any notes on GL mapping or recommended invoice descriptions?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[karthik.iyer@redwood.ai]
[Attachment: commitment_sweep_schedule_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 110KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-03T10:08:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Annual commitment — invoicing & tax coordination (internal)

Soojin / Karthik — putting down a few operational points from finance/tax to avoid rework once invoices are issued: 

- GL mapping: use CODE 4-200 (Committed Revenue) for the annual invoice and CODE 4-210 (Usage Revenue) for monthly sweep adjustments. Include "Committed 2027 - OmniHealth" in the invoice description to help their ERP match.
- VAT / Withholding guidance:
   * UK: PwC recommends reverse-charge wording when OmniHealth is VAT-registered (we should mark invoice with "Reverse charge applies – Article 194/..." and include OMH VAT number).
   * India: Clients often withhold 2% service tax / TDS on cross-border SaaS depending on treaty. If OmniHealth withholds, they must send a tax certificate; we'll apply credit against the commitment.
- Gross-up policy: Redwood will not gross-up automatically. If the customer requests net payment treatment with gross-up, we need a finance approval and a one-time gross-up fee to keep economics neutral.
- Timing: First sweep date suggested in the schedule is 2026-11-15 (to allow for signed MOA and treasury cut-offs). If AP needs earlier, we can accommodate but will need Fedwire vs ACH instructions.

Attaching the brief tax memo we got from PwC's UK team for reference — it covers reverse-charge language and expected documentation.

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: tax-opinion-UK-IN.pdf (pdf, 92KB)]
